concept: ECS on Fargate: containers without managing servers
tests: Choosing container orchestration with minimal operational overhead and serverless compute.
expected: Amazon ECS with the Fargate launch type — no control plane and no instances to manage. Triggers: "avoid managing the control plane", "serverless compute for tasks", "least operational overhead".
why_not: Self-managed Kubernetes and the EC2 launch type require patching and capacity management; cron on a single VM — no orchestration or fault tolerance.
